common_ground.text: The ZIP has no answer for ZEC's price moving again. Some fear a rise will bring the dispute back; others fear a fall will leave ZCG short.
Several posters on different sides regret how fast and how heated the past days have been.

output.headline: Whether to back the Future Dev and Legal Defense Fund ZIP, a compromise on ZCG's funding and treasury
output.next: Rival ZIP authors are asked to withdraw: artkor has joined, thowar2 will if ZCG drops its own plan. FPF says the donation needs a community vote and an accepted ZIP.

stakes.decision: Whether the Future Dev and Legal Defense Fund ZIP is adopted. FPF says the donation needs an affirmative community vote and an accepted ZIP; the thread sets no date.

unresolved.text: Can the ZCG funds FPF already holds legally go to the NSM? str4d reads ZIP 1015 as barring it; FPF says its counsel cleared it, but no details of the restrictions were given.
Why about 55% of ZCG's ZEC, and what happens if ZEC's price moves again?
Who the legal defense fund would help, who would run and oversee it, and how lockbox money gets allocated.

best_against.quote: A midpoint between two positions isn't a justification. That's the argument to moderation.

best_for.quote: the program was necessary to sustain and develop Zcash for many years, including funding the only working wallets for years, and the development of coin-holder voting

views.label: Back the compromise ZIP
views.one_line: A workable compromise: ZCG keeps running on a smaller treasury, its future funding ends, and a legal fund is created. Rival ZIPs should be withdrawn so everyone moves forward together.

best_against.quote: Coinholders can always vote more funds to ZCG (from the coinholder grants lockbox) if it is deemed necessary to sustain Zcash.

best_for.quote: That describes the number. It doesn't derive it. Nothing in the ZIP says why 55% is right rather than 30% or 80%.

views.label: Not as drafted: fix the amount and mechanism
views.one_line: The amount isn't derived from a goal, a fixed cut is a price bet, and the lockbox has no process to allocate its funds. Some add the coinholder fund must be treated the same.

best_against.quote: as long as there is an affirmative community vote in favor of the proposal and an accepted ZIP the donation can be legally completed.

best_for.quote: It is actively disrespectful to existing and long-standing, well-respected Zcash stakeholders to act at the speed that this manufactured emergency is suggesting you need to.

views.label: Reject it, or slow down
views.one_line: There is no emergency, so slow down and give the community months. Some call moving ZCG's funds theft; one calls the legal fund a liability shield for core founders at network expense.

output.why_it_matters: The ZIP would end ZCG's future funding, donate part of its treasury to the NSM, let ZCG keep the rest, and create a Future Dev and Legal Defense Fund.
